name: @brooswit/thatch
description: Elysia plugin: a central HTTP MCP server with named connections and a channel for pushing messages into Claude Code sessions

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/testing/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --sourcemap=external --external elysia --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external zod && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts
scripts.check: bun run generate && bun run typecheck && bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts && bun run scripts/verify-generated-is-committed.ts
